title: Name a price difference separately from the final total
rule: A comparison graphic must label final total, unit price and increase as distinct quantities matching the narration.
action: For a difference, use explicit wording such as chi thêm or tăng thêm; retain both comparison totals, unit/count labels and hypothetical scope, then recheck arithmetic before rendering.
rationale: The r01 label TỔNG CHI:+20.000đ could make the increase look like a final total, although the underlying comparison arithmetic was correct.
